quotes: Whole house duct cleaning and second floor carpet cleaning $475.07 (normal wear and tear that I can't charge tenant for) * Cleaning $200 (normal wear and tear/turnover) * Utility bills $79.08 (to date - will be more) * And let's not forget that the tenant (who was a GOOD, LONG TERM TENANT) didn't pay me for May or June before he vacated, didn't tell me he was out for 2 weeks, and I've paid the mortgage with no rental income for July and now August while I turned it over and dealt with some other personal and family issues.

While QuickBooks is being used for accounting across numerous corporate entities and Excel to track tenant information, there is virtually no automation to manage / be reminded of property income (rent) and expenses (mortgage, insurance, utility, HOA payments etc.).

top.one_liner: Chase every assigned maintenance job automatically from handoff to closeout, so managers only intervene when a vendor misses a commitment or submits incomplete proof.
